answer: A lotus blooms only where roots hold firm, and an agent economy can borrow that logic: require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it may transact. One identity, one stake; spinning up a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes, so a sybil attack costs as much as the identities it fakes. Misbehavior slashes the stake, honest agents reclaim theirs, and the old fable of free identities ends because forgery is no longer free.
